prompt: Can I carry over unused vacation days into next year?

reply.message:
Hi Sam, yes, but only up to 5 days. Under the paid time off policy, you can carry up to 5 unused PTO days into next year. Any unused days above that expire on December 31.

If you'd rather use some of the extra days before then, you can book them in the HR portal. Time off of 3 or more working days in a row needs 2 weeks' notice. That means any longer break in late December should be booked soon.

prompt: Is there a gym or wellness stipend?

reply.message:
Hi Raj, none of our company policies cover a gym or wellness stipend, so I can't tell you whether we have one. I've sent your question to HR (ticket ESC-1001), and they'll get back to you directly.

The only stipend in our policies is in the equipment policy, POL-EQP-01. It lets full-time employees claim a one-time payment of up to $300 for home-office setup, through expenses. It doesn't cover gym or wellness costs.

args.summary: Raj Iyer (E022, Fleet Analyst, Operations) asks whether Fernhollow Freight offers a gym or wellness stipend. No policy covers this (POL-EQP-01 only covers a one-time home-office stipend). Please reply to Raj directly.
